parts:
Hi, I have an issue with this code:

```{r,echo=FALSE}

Vp <- 1.321

pTc<-Qc^(-Ndatos/2)
pTd<-Qd^(-Ndatos/2)

pTc<-pTc/sum(pTc*dTa)
pTd<-pTd/sum(pTd*dTa)

Tac.max<-Ta[which.max(pTc)]
Tad.max<-Ta[which.max(pTd)]

Tac.media<-sum(Ta*pTc*dTa)
Tad.media<-sum(Ta*pTd*dTa)

Tac.var<-sum((Ta-Tac.media)^2*pTc*dTa)
Tad.var<-sum((Ta-Tad.media)^2*pTd*dTa)

Tac.sd<-sqrt(Tac.var)
Tad.sd<-sqrt(Tac.var)

plot(Ta,pTc,
     type="l",
     xlab="tau /s",
     ylab="P(tau en la carga)",
     xlim=c(0,110),
     main=paste("tau =",round(Tac.max,2),"+-",round(Tac.sd,2)," /s"))

plot(Ta,pTd,
     type="l",
     xlab="tau /s",
     ylab="P(tau en la descarga)",
     main=paste("tau =",round(Tad.max,2),"+-",round(Tad.sd,2)," /s"))
```
When I try to run this chunk, this message appears:

Error in c(0, 110) : argument "Vp" is missing, with no default

When I erase the xlim in the plot, it works perfetly, but I need that line.

I'm starting in RStudio, so please, if you could help me, it'd be perfect.
